record.summary: An agent given a work order today has no declared answer to "what must I have read before I can act on this". A ContextClosure declares that set explicitly: the specs, sections and obligations a piece of work is answerable to. It is a declaration of what was named, never a proof that the naming is complete. Deferred: specified now, built when a consumer names the need.
